selector.rationale: Evidence of interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates with variation in fiber size, centrally located nuclei, necrosis, and regeneration on muscle biopsy supports polymyositis, while rhabdomyolysis is also a strong consideration due to elevated CK and myoglobin levels.

rejected.label: Myelitis
rejected.why: Although spinal MRI demonstrated a hyperintense lesion concerning for myelitis, the overall clinical presentation and laboratory findings more strongly support polymyositis.

rejected.label: Myocarditis
rejected.why: While cardiac MRI confirmed myocarditis, the patient's primary presentation and muscle biopsy results point more directly to polymyositis as the champion diagnosis.
